name: Mohammad Ripan
headline: Mohammad Ripan.
intro: Technical lead for distributed compute, AI inference infrastructure, and scalable execution architectures. I design the systems that keep LLM serving, agent workflows, and scientific workloads fast and reliable, and I still write the code.
about: I'm a Senior Machine Learning Systems Engineer and technical lead specializing in distributed compute, AI inference infrastructure, and scalable execution architectures. My work covers vLLM-based LLM serving, distributed workflow orchestration, conversational AI systems, and real-time speech processing experiments.

I've architected asynchronous compute platforms for distributed inference, scientific workloads, and heterogeneous execution environments. Before that I worked on banking backends, warehouse robotics, hospital automation, and award-winning applied IoT research. Across all of it I care about latency you can measure, infrastructure other teams can reuse, and keeping my hands in the code.
